name: 5-Stat Crit Jewel (OneManLeft, 0.5.0)
starting_state: rare jewel with 2 desired suffixes (e.g., crit chance + crit multi)
target: 5-stat jewel with 3 locked suffixes at 1.6x effect + 1 effect prefix + 1 chaos-rolled prefix
notes: Adapted from OneManLeft's 0.5.0 jewel crafting discovery.
KEY MECHANIC: Liquid Contempt adds +1 suffix/prefix as a crafted mod. Only 1 crafted mod allowed.
KEY INSIGHT: When item has 3 suffixes and NO +1 suffix line, chaos orbs CANNOT touch suffixes.
The chaos orb tries to remove a suffix, can't add one back (full), so it blocks. On retry, it picks a prefix instead.
This makes prefix rolling completely deterministic after locking suffixes.
Liquid Ferocity adds (40-60)% increased Effect of Suffixes (as prefix). Guaranteed because it can't remove suffixes.
Total expected cost: ~30-50 divines for endgame mirror-tier jewels.
Works with Adorned for even more power.

steps.precondition: Rare jewel with 2 desired suffixes (e.g., crit chance + crit multi), has at least 1 mod to remove
steps.result: Removes 1 random non-crafted mod, adds +1 Suffix Modifier allowed as crafted prefix (50/50 to hit suffix removal)
steps.note: Potent Liquid Contempt removes 1 mod and adds +1 suffix as a crafted prefix. If it removes the wrong suffix, start over with a new jewel. Cost: ~1.5 div per attempt + jewel base (~20 exalts).

steps.precondition: Rare jewel with 2 desired suffixes + crafted +1 suffix prefix, open suffix slot
steps.result: Guaranteed desecrated suffix mod added (omen forces suffix slot)
steps.note: Preserved Cranium is a desecration currency for jewels. Dextral Necromancy omen guarantees the desecrated mod goes to suffix. This fills suffix slot 3.

steps.precondition: Rare jewel with desecrated suffix from step 2, want to reroll the desecrated mod
steps.result: Rerolls the desecrated mod options — repeat until desired suffix appears
steps.note: Abyssal Echoes omen lets you reroll desecrated options when revealing. Keep going until you hit the desired 3rd suffix (e.g., crit multi). Each attempt costs a cranium + omen.

steps.precondition: Rare jewel with 3 locked suffixes + crafted +1 suffix prefix that needs removal
steps.result: Removes the crafted +1 suffix prefix — jewel now has 3 suffixes and NO +1 suffix line
steps.note: This is the critical step. After removing the +1 suffix crafted prefix, the jewel has 3 natural suffixes and 0-2 prefixes. The +1 suffix line is gone, which locks chaos orbs to prefix-only rolling.

steps.precondition: Rare jewel with 3 suffixes, no +1 suffix line, 1-2 prefixes to reroll
steps.goal: Desired prefix mod (e.g., spell damage, flat damage)
steps.note: CHAOS ORBS CAN ONLY AFFECT PREFIXES. When the jewel has 3 suffixes and no +1 suffix line, the chaos orb tries to remove a suffix, finds it can't add one back (full), and blocks. On retry it picks a prefix instead. This is deterministic prefix-only rolling.

steps.precondition: Rare jewel with 3 locked suffixes + 2 good prefixes
steps.result: Removes 1 prefix, adds (40-60)% increased Effect of Suffixes as crafted prefix
steps.note: Potent Liquid Ferocity removes a random mod and adds 'increased Effect of Suffixes' as a prefix. It CANNOT remove a suffix (same lock trick). So it always removes a prefix and adds the effect mod. Divine to 60% for max power.

cost_analysis.liquid_contempt: ~1.5 div per attempt (50/50 to hit suffix removal)
